The answer comes from my recollection of this problem (I believe it is from HMMT), not from a full derivation or a simulation of all 20 coins. I did hand-simulate the first three cases and got stopping times of 1, 2 and 8 procedures for 1, 2 and 3 tails coins. These are consistent with a rapidly growing sequence, but they do not confirm the value for 20 coins.

ANSWER: 6098
